tool_quality_note: 当前内置工具未暴露模型选择、质量档、采样步数或种子参数，未虚报具体质量档。

rejected_attempts.prompt:
Perform a narrowly targeted transparency correction on this exact image, preserving its existing 1024 x 1536 canvas, all paper positions, shape, colors, painted detail and silhouette.
OUTPUT A REAL RGBA PNG / 透明背景.
Every visible piece of parchment must be completely opaque: alpha=255 throughout its full painted interior, including light cream brushwork, pale highlights and dusty rose paper. Do not make the paper translucent. Preserve all interior RGB colors exactly rather than blending or whitening them. Background pixels outside the paper silhouette must be alpha=0, not a colored gradient, glow, shadow or checkerboard. Permit fractional alpha ONLY in the outermost 1–2 pixels of silhouette antialiasing. Eliminate stray almost-transparent pixels floating outside the silhouette.
Do not add or remove paper layers, resize, crop, scale, shift, redraw, recolor, embellish or change the accepted artwork. No text, labels, characters, buttons, symbols, border or other objects. This is only an opacity/alpha correction of the same final fully opened blank parchment card animation frame.
